description: Hello, we are Cosmic Chaos, a group of 5 engineering students who are movitated to work on real life problems and passionate about space and engineering.
summary:
During long-duration missions, astronauts need to know which changes in their health warrant a closer look. A single reading offers limited context. CosBEAT is an astronaut health monitoring and decision-support software for woman that brings vital-sign trends, mission context, and daily self-reports into one dashboard. Menstrual-health check-ins give women’s health an explicit place in routine monitoring.

The dashboard combines heart rate, sleep, oxygen saturation, and temperature with research-informed comparisons. When CosBEAT flags a change, astronauts can inspect the underlying trend and ask the assistant to explain what the dashboard is showing. The demo follows this workflow from Earth through transit to a lunar scenario, using replayed reference data where available and simulated readings for transit and lunar operations.

CosBEAT helps astronauts decide what to monitor, review, or bring to crew medical support. Live telemetry and clinical validation are future milestones, and hands-free wake-word activation remains experimental. Next steps include integrating compatible wearables, validating astronaut-specific baselines, and developing medically reviewed escalation workflows.

When Earth is out of reach, your health shouldn’t be.
details: CosBEAT is a health monitoring prototype that helps astronauts recognize changes in their health during long-duration space missions. It combines heart rate, sleep, blood oxygen, and temperature trends with mission context and daily check-ins for symptoms, fatigue, and optional menstrual-health tracking. When a reading is flagged, astronauts can review what changed and ask an AI assistant for a plain-language explanation by typing or using a microphone. We built CosBEAT with JavaScript, React, Vite, and browser speech tools. The demo uses replayed research data and simulated mission readings, and the software is designed for future integration with health-monitoring wearables from different brands. Our team considered readability, privacy, and clear labeling of data sources. By connecting alerts, trends, and self-reported symptoms in one workflow, CosBEAT aims to help astronauts decide what to keep monitoring and what to bring to crew medical support.
